methodology.title: Regular monthly actuarial APR — captured US method
methodology.formula: AF=sum(P/(1+i)^k); APR%=1200i. Exact rational root enclosure proves nearest0.01percentage point; exact halfway/unresolved cases reject.
methodology.domain: Positive supplied legally classified AF/payment;2–360equal full monthly payments on original day1–28; dates2000–2099. Root0<=i<=1/month; at most128exact bisections, unresolved enclosures reject; no general fee classifier.
methodology.deferred: Actual transaction rule-version/applicability, irregular/odd/EOM calendars, USRule, fee classification and tie policy.
